Priya Rao: Vendor update: H200 test fleet has unexpected thermal throttling on latest silicon batch. They suggest limiting sustained workloads until microcode patch. Thoughts on launch posture?

Tom Ellis: Can we regionize? Hold EU/APAC, do US-only initial wave. Keeps press date intact.

Nadia Gomez: Comms caveat: need to avoid 'full availability' language. We'll call it 'limited regional availability; select regions only'.

VendorOps (Sam): We can carve out 40 H200 units for US-west and guarantee no throttling after throttle-guard enabled. ETA for patch across all units ~3 weeks.

Priya Rao: Okay. Runtime needs fallback policy: prefer H200 where throttling-guard is present, else fall back to H100 or B200. Tom, can you add a per-node capability tag?

Tom Ellis: Yep. Adding node label hw:throttle_guard=true/false and routing rule to prefer nodes with true. Will open PR for rule by tomorrow.

marketplace-bot: Notice: marketplace image rI-2026-04-h100 deployed to staging 2026-04-21T20:01:10Z.

Nadia Gomez: Action items: I'll update partner comms and the public availability page to show regions + capacity levels. Priya, include legal on embargo wording.

Priya Rao: Will do. We'll aim for a controlled US wave on 2026-05-05 and a global ramp once microcode patch is validated. Reconvene after vendor confirms guard rollout.
